fields.notes: Частичная исследовательская реконструкция мысленного опыта §36: при допущениях о данном нам мире влечений и действующей воле испытывается единая волевая причинность. Итоговая характеристика мира волей к власти дополнительно зависит от успешного объяснения всей жизни влечений и органических функций из одной основной формы воли. Выполнение этих условий остаётся открытым.

assumptions: Only the world of drives and passions is given as real within the opening supposition.
Will is acknowledged as causally effective for the hypothetical sole-causality trial.
Mechanical occurrences are examined as potentially of the same reality rank as affect, not merely as appearance.
For the final consequence, the whole life of drives must be successfully explained from one basic form of will, will to power.
For that consequence, all organic functions must be reducible to that will, including the linked problem of generation and nutrition.
semantic_content.examined_consequence: If the further explanatory reductions succeeded, the passage proposes characterizing all effective force, and the world considered from within, as will to power. Their success remains an open condition.
semantic_content.scenario_account: Suppose drives and passions are the only reality given to us, and examine whether the mechanical world can be understood from the same order through a sole will-causality trial.
